Name: Freedom Planet 2 Plushies
Author: empressoflight
Description:
replaces the small junimo plushes into team lilac (excluding torque/neera) and serpentine! this is my first mod (and first time doing pixel art) lol

you can now have team lilac in the comfort of your farmhouse... in a form of a plush! serpentine is here too, i suppose
we need more freedom planet mods im ngl

[size=1](i also wouldve made neera instead of serpentine, but im a huge serpentine fan so i couldnt help it)[/size]

requires content patcher :-)

freedom planet and its characters belong to galaxytrail and ziyo ling!! PLEASEEE support them and play their amazing game i couldnt recommend it enough
